rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency because stored rows carry UNIT_USD, but the raw SOI schedule shows the cost and fair value columns are dollar-denominated. Representative row 178:5 has explicit dollar markers in the Cost and Fair Value columns, and the schedule total at 179:41 is also dollar-denominated. UNIT_USD is therefore a USD unit-label variant, not a non-USD source currency defect.
